183:t_004:29.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're a fine one to talk...」

183:t_004:30.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, support $$スカル$$ 4 and annihilate the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

183:t_004:31.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I figure these guys are after Earth or the colonies! Don't you dare let them through!」

183:t_005:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「If we keep this up, we can win...!」

183:t_005:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「...What the hell is this, ever since a while ago!」

183:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Unknown energy detected near Ensign $$アルト$$'s current position.」

183:t_007:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You figured it out well, Wingless.」

183:t_007:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「B-Big Sis...! He's a beauty! So decadent and pretty! But he's definitely a bad guy!」

183:t_007:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Stop making such a fuss over everything! Now that you're a member of $c, don't panic no matter what shows up!」

183:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「《$$頭翅#keyword$$》...! Is that guy Toma of the $$堕天翅$$s!?」

183:t_007:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No, $$勝平$$! That guy isn't $$頭翅#pilot$$!」

183:t_007:5.en:
$$シン$$
「That's a being born from $$頭翅#pilot$$'s hatred... It's $$ミカゲ$$!」

183:t_007:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So he's the one who manipulated the people of the world called $$アルテア$$ and started a war!」

183:t_007:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Trying to destroy everything out of hatred...」

183:t_007:8.en:
$$メール$$
「So basically he got dumped and is taking it all out on everybody out of spite, huh!」

183:t_007:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「What does that jerk with the misplaced grudge want!」

183:t_007:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「More familiar faces have joined us... As I thought, this is a world burdened with the fate of becoming the end of the myth...」

183:t_007:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And you are the factors who were branded with the $$烙印$$ and gathered here...」

183:t_007:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... $$早乙女アルト$$... I came to welcome you.」

183:t_007:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Th-that person... a man!? Or a woman!? Uh... huh? Before that, is $$アルト$$ a man? Or a woman!?」

183:t_007:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So you're the one who's been making me see nightmares...!」

183:t_007:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... So to you, that was a nightmare...」

183:t_007:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One who is chosen, and one who chooses... One who was not chosen, and one who has no choice but to choose... That is why I want you.」

183:t_007:20.en:
$$アルト$$
「This guy...! Is he planning to do it all over again, like when he used $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$!」

183:t_007:21.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you call the name of the girl with the pale pink and gold hair before that of the girl with the spring-green hair...」

183:t_008:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「But there aren't any humans aboard!」

183:t_008:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That bastard! He's turned $$アルテア$$'s weapons into his own arms and legs!」

183:t_008:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come now, $$アルト$$... Let me invite you to my side.」

183:t_009:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I sense hesitation in his wings! That is not his usual movement!」

183:t_009:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're reaping what you sowed, $$アルト$$. All of this was brought about by your sin.」

183:t_010:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「He really doesn't pick his targets, does he!」

183:t_010:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Same old unprincipled bastard as ever!」

183:t_010:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$アルト$$... No one stands between you and me.」

183:t_010:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How long will that bravado last?」

183:t_012:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you all right, $$アルト$$!」

183:t_012:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「So that's the $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$ we've heard about!」

183:t_012:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It really does look just like $$アポロ$$'s $$アクエリオン$$.」

183:t_012:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And on top of that, it even pulls off the Infinity Punch! This is getting me fired up!」

183:t_012:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Today, we were interrupted. Let us meet again, $$アルト$$.」

183:t_012:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wretch like you has no right to call me by name like that, winged dog.」

183:t_012:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Someday I will make you taste my anger... my hatred... too! Down to the marrow of your bones!」

183:t_013:0.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That guy... he's still trapped in hatred, isn't he.」

183:t_013:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And he means to fight in order to vent it, then.」

183:t_013:2.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Save the talk for later, you guys!」

183:t_013:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アンディ$$! When did you get on the $$クォーター$$!」

183:t_013:4.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$アンディ$$ isn't the only one here, you know.」

183:t_013:5.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Of course, we're here too!」

183:t_013:7.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Sorry... Even we can't explain it well.」

183:t_013:8.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Under Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s command, we were getting special training on $$翠の地球$$ to hone our $$エレメント$$ abilities even further, but...」

183:t_013:9.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Suddenly we were told, 'The time has come...!' and got warped here.」

183:t_013:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Another one of his crazy demands!」

kept_omissions: 183:t_011:1/2: Rand's sentence is left hanging and $n completes it ('That was...' / 'A punch!'), as in the Japanese.
uncertain: 183:t_007:0/012:7 & 007: Mikage's epithets: 翅無し = 'Wingless', 翅犬 = 'winged dog' (no established English; other slices, e.g. 2026_11 翅犬ポロン, should match).
183:t_012:4: 無限拳 = 'Infinity Punch' (no glossary entry; matches the Aquarion dub).
183:t_007:20: subject of the past 'used Sheryl and Ranka in the Time Prison War' is elided; I read it as Mikage (こいつ) with 'he'.
183:t_007:21: 薄紅と金の髪の少女 / 若草の髪の少女 rendered as colour epithets (pale pink and golden / fresh green hair), identities not named.
183:t_013:9/10: 'あの人' = Fudou (from slice 2026_11 context); Malloy's 言われて kept passive ('we were told').
183:t_004:29: Kaname's reply to Sousuke ('You're a fine one to talk...') inferred from the preceding row.
183:t_005:3: Alto's 何なんだよ aimed at the unseen presence, not Michel; written without an object.
183:t_010:0: Mao's subject-less 見境無しとはね read as Mikage, 'He'.
